text:
mira: Quick follow-up on the pin/versioning RFC - we're seeing metrics drift when tenant softbinds interact with weighted rollouts. Need a short decision on precedence and migration.

tony: Outline the root cause in two lines?

mira: Rollout expands to variant weights and emits rollout_token. Resolver later applies tenant softbind and rewrites final model id. Telemetry ties to rollout_token so final calls are misattributed.

liam: Oof. Options: 1) server-finalize routing and return resolved_variant header, 2) add pin-level precedence enum, 3) block tenant softbinds during active rollouts.

anya: Blocking is rough for customers. Server-finalize needs api/contract work. Pin-level enum seems lowest-friction.

mira: Agreed. Proposal: add `precedence` enum on pins/rollout manifests with values `rollout_first`, `tenant_first`, `merge`. Default = `rollout_first` for backwards compat.

ton y: Typo in name :) but yes. Explain `merge` semantics?

liam: Merge = apply both hints and let server recompute deterministic final weights (server wins tiebreaks). This preserves canaries while honoring tenant overrides where possible.

mira: TTL interaction: propose `effective_expiry = min(pin_expiry, rollout_expiry)` unless precedence==tenant_first and tenant explicitly requested longer TTL. Avoid ghost pins post-rollout.

anya: Also add `expiry_reason` enum for auditing: `manual`, `rollout_end`, `tenant_override`, `system_gc`. Store in pin_resolutions.

liam: Telemetry changes: resolution event should include `resolved_variant`, `precedence_applied`, `effective_expiry`, `final_source`. Quick probe: `SELECT count(*) FROM pin_resolutions WHERE resolved_variant IS NULL` to find gaps.

mira: Migration plan: schema-v2 feature-flagged. Backfill rules: rollout manifests -> `rollout_first`. Tenant pins created within last 90d -> keep `tenant_first` if they set priority; otherwise `merge`. Run dry-count probe before flipping behavior.

anya: Client-side: log non-fatal warn when client applies softbind but server_precedence=`rollout_first`. Keep warn silent by default, opt-in verbose with env var.

liam: Ops wave: shard-by-tenant backfill in cohorts, monitor `precedence_mismatch_rate`. Abort if >0.5% sustained over 10m.

mira: Docs: update pin schema examples, show `merge` edgecases and note: "If you rely on tenant overrides during canaries, set precedence=tenant_first explicitly."

ops-bot: migration job #9211: pin-schema-v2 dry-run scheduled on staging -> will emit mismatch_report to #eng-sre.

mira: Action items: 1) PR schema + migration script (mira), 2) telemetry spec + kibana queries (liam), 3) client shim warn + tests (anya), 4) ops wave plan (tony). I'll create tickets and link.

liam: One more small ask: add a one-time probe that counts `server_precedence='rollout_first' AND client_applied_softbind=true` so we can measure how much routing currently diverges.

mira: Good call, include that in the dry-run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
